 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. Welcome to another Miami Hurricanes game day everyone!
 Your Miami Hurricanes are back in action for Homecoming! Here to meet them for a grudge match on multiple levels are the Duke Blue Devils.
 After the loss at Notre Dame, Miami is ranked #7 in the College Football Playoff Rankings. Unranked but 7-2, Duke enters this game looking to pull a major upset and get some revenge. Their coach was fired by Miami to make way for Mario Cristobal; and Miami's star QB and WR (Barkate, not Toney) both left Duke in the portal to take their talents to South Beach (it's a phrase, you know what I mean). Anyways, there are many reasons why Duke wants to win this game, and ditto that for a Hurricanes team looking to return to the CFP this season.
